name: dev/acting-as-silas
preview: When you need to check a Heart Rush change in a browser — signed in on production as Silas, or on a local dev server — read this because his Arc browser is already reachable over CDP and the dev server needs a seeded session, so you never need to ask him to click or paste.

revisions.author: 3zl47w7d-mvhfwmuj-a16b6656
revisions.body:
# Checking Heart Rush in a browser

Northlight sign-in only redirects to the registered hosts (production, and localhost:3911/3912 in the source checkout), so where you check decides how you get a signed-in session. Never ask Silas to click through or paste a snippet; see [[act-in-silas-logged-in-app]].

## On production, as Silas

His Arc browser exposes CDP on port 9222 and is signed in to play.heartrush.party and tools.heartrush.party.

- Open a tab on the site you need: `crtr capture tab open --port 9222 <url>`, then run code there with `crtr capture page exec --port 9222 --target <tab id> '<js>'`. `fetch` from that tab carries his `hr_session` cookie.
- Open the tab on the origin you are calling. A `fetch` from a play tab to tools (or the reverse) is cross-origin and fails even though the cookie is shared across `.heartrush.party`.
- Close the tabs you opened; leave his other tabs alone.
- Playwright specs in `apps/play/e2e` attach to the same browser over CDP (`PLAY_CDP`, default `http://localhost:9222`) and run against production: `pnpm --filter play e2e`. They open and close their own tabs and use one worker because they share his account's data. Things the specs create are named `V1 Hero` and `V1 Campaign`.
- Anything that needs a real Northlight run (the AI features) can only be checked here: the local dev user has no Northlight connection, so a dev server cannot produce a real reply.

## On a local dev server

Start and stop the server as [[heart-rush-tools/dev/shared-machine]] says (own port, never 3912, killed before you finish).

- Seed a user and a session row in the local `AUTH_DB` the way `apps/play/test/*.test.ts` and `apps/play/scripts/deploy.ts` do: `INSERT INTO user (id, display_name) …` and `INSERT INTO session (id, user_id, expires_at) …` (tools' `session` table is the one session store play reads). Set that id as the `hr_session` cookie.
- Drive headless Chrome with `crtr capture` (`crtr capture -h`), and quit any browser you launched before you finish.

summary: Production checks go through Silas's Arc over CDP port 9222 (capture tab open, page exec, pnpm --filter play e2e); dev checks seed a user and session and use headless Chrome.
why_it_exists: Agents verifying play and tools changes asked Silas to try things by hand, or tried cross-origin fetches from the wrong tab, instead of driving his signed-in browser.
